title: Free-trial auto-renewal refund
summary: A free trial converted to paid without clear consent — request a full refund and cancellation.
goal_default: Please refund the charge in full and cancel the plan.

rights.claim: Unclear trial-to-paid conversions have been found deceptive by regulators.
rights.basis: FTC actions on negative-option / auto-renewal disclosures; EU unfair commercial practices.

rights.claim: You can ask them to point to where explicit auto-renewal consent was obtained.

artifact.subject: Refund — free trial auto-converted without clear consent

disclaimer: This is information to help you write your own request. It is not legal advice and guarantees no outcome.
